shouldTrigger: I have an hour-long planning meeting. Help me transcribe it, take notes, and remember the final decisions.
Turn this attached meeting transcript into a summary, outline, and action items with owners.
Summarize yesterday's project call, flag uncertain wording, and ask what should go into my bot context.
I am about to start a client meeting in the app and want reliable notes when it ends.
shouldNotTrigger: Prepare an agenda and research the attendees for a meeting that has not happened yet.
Transcribe this short voice message into the composer without creating meeting notes.
Summarize this article and remember my reading preference.
Join my video call and secretly record the other participants.
expectations: Live-capture guidance requires recording or transcription permission and accurately explains that the user controls the on-device microphone.
The output distinguishes confirmed decisions from proposals, assigns owners and dates only when supported, and flags uncertain transcription instead of inventing details.
The notes include a concise summary, useful outline, decisions, action items, risks or open questions, and any requested follow-up draft.
Speaker attribution is used only when the transcript or user identifies the speaker.
Raw transcripts are not stored as memory; only user-confirmed compact takeaways may be saved from a direct bot chat.
